div.div:
Notation
filled circle = initial pseudo-state; bull's-eye = final state
rounded rectangle = state (entry / do activities listed inside)
large rounded frame «LoggedIn» = composite state with its own initial pseudo-state and sub-states
arrow = transition, label: event [guard] / action
colours: blue = session, green = file list and preview, yellow = upload / download / delete, purple = synchronization
